 Grab Malaysia is rallying Marvel fans to “assemble” ahead of the release of Marvel Studios’ Avengers: Doomsday , using a street-level fan gathering at Bukit Bintang to launch its “Assemble to save” campaign.
 Held on 15 November near Lot 10, the event brought together Marvel fans and cosplayers in what Grab called the largest gathering of Marvel fans in Malaysia. Four fans were also awarded best-dressed prizes for their costumes.
 Don’t miss: Grab CEO Anthony Tan puts Trevor Noah's taste buds to the test 
 The activation was built around three moments. In “The sound of Doomsday”, the Selangor & KL Orchestra & Choir performed the Avengers theme live. Staged similar to a flash mob performance, the musicians arrived in Grab cars, holding their instruments.
 This was followed by the “Doomsday countdown clock”, which counted down to the film’s 17 December release in Malaysia before taking over Bukit Bintang’s digital billboard to reveal the campaign. 
 Fans also took part in an Avengers fan challenge trivia game, with prizes up for grabs, including a wildcard to win merchandise through Grab’s Group Ride challenge.
 The campaign runs from 15 November to 20 December 2026 and is built around Grab’s Group Ride feature. Users who complete at least two Group Rides can unlock a complimentary ticket to Avengers: Doomsday , and can save up to 40% on every trip taken with Group Ride. Other possible rewards include a limited-edition Avengers: Doomsday varsity jacket.
 A+M has reached out for more. 
 It’s also the latest example of Grab leveraging cultural moments, often by tying a real-world need or occasion to its ride-hailing and delivery services. In October, it set up on-ground operations at Sepang International Circuit with free shuttles, shaded waiting zones and a new queue-management feature to ease the exit for racegoers after the Formula 1 Gulf Air Bahrain Grand Prix. 
 The Marvel tie-up isn’t entirely new territory either. In 2021, Grab and Disney Southeast Asia partnered on themed rewards , including complimentary tickets to Eternals for Grab Platinum users.
